blocks.title: Drafting with a real command line
blocks.description: A command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions and hatches — the upstream CADCraft drawing editor running inside Astravia, on the drawing you opened in the workspace.

showcase.assistant_reply: OFFSET 100 ran on the interior set, corners trimmed. Not saved.

items.title: The drafting habits you already have
items.description: Type L, click two points, type @5<45 — LINE, PLINE, ARC, RECTANG, SPLINE, TRIM, OFFSET, FILLET and the rest answer through the command line, with prompts, aliases and direct distance entry.

items.title: Drawings in your project
items.description: DXF reads (R12–2018, ASCII and binary) and writes; DWG opens through the open-source acadrust library; the result goes back to the workspace instead of a downloads folder.

items.title: Ask what is on the drawing
items.description: A capture tool saves a PNG of what the canvas is showing and a status tool reports whether the editor finished starting, so the agent can check its own work instead of assuming.

items.title: Commands typed, not guessed
items.description: The agent types at the command line the way you do — L, then two points, then a radius — and snaps to existing geometry instead of clicking at coordinates it invented.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: About 11 MB of editor files arrive on first open, into the plugin's data directory, and are reused offline after that.

items.title: Open it from the composer
items.description: Press / or the first button left of the composer and pick CADCraft from the plugin list. Its tab opens with it, and a toggle appears in the input bar. Turning the toggle off drops that context — it does not close the document you are editing.

items.title: Select a drawing, then open it
items.description: File → Open inside the editor takes the file selected in Astravia rather than showing a system dialog.

items.title: Plot or export back through the workspace
items.description: SVG, PNG and PDF plotting travel the same bridge as saves, so the result lands where you chose.

blocks.content: CADCraft describes itself as early and fast-moving: entities it does not model yet are not kept on save. The plugin runs whatever the pinned release does — it adds no drawing features of its own.

Commands are typed at the command line and points are picked the way you would pick them, one step at a time. Before reporting that a drawing changed it reads the canvas back, so “done” means the drawing visibly moved.
